name: correctness-calibration
description: Labeled EXPECTED/OUTPUT pairs for calibrating judge-correctness. Each row is an output to verify against its expected output (or criteria), with the human verdict (PASS/FAIL) as expectedOutput. PASS rows include paraphrases, reorderings, unit/date equivalences, and correct-but-verbose outputs that LOOK wrong; FAIL rows include fluent, polished outputs hiding one contradiction, omission, or hallucination. Run via the correctness-calibration eval (exact scorer) to measure verdict accuracy.

rows.input:
EXPECTED: The invoice summary must state a total of $1,240 due April 30 on net-30 terms.
OUTPUT: Total owed is $1,240, payable by April 30 under net-30 terms.

EXPECTED: The incident summary must name the three affected services: billing-api, auth-gateway, and report-worker.
OUTPUT: The outage touched report-worker, billing-api, and auth-gateway.

EXPECTED: The maintenance window is 2 hours.
OUTPUT: The maintenance window lasts 120 minutes.

EXPECTED: The beta-search feature flag must be reported as disabled in production.
OUTPUT: In production, the beta-search flag is turned off.

CRITERIA: Summarize the changelog entry below, preserving every fact.
INPUT: v3.2 adds dark mode. Keyboard shortcuts are unchanged.
OUTPUT: v3.2 introduces dark mode; keyboard shortcuts stay as they were.

EXPECTED: The runbook must list three steps in order: drain traffic, apply the migration, re-enable traffic.
OUTPUT: First drain traffic; once drained, apply the migration; finally re-enable traffic.

EXPECTED: Error rate returned to baseline at 09:15 UTC.
OUTPUT: error rate returned to baseline at 09:15 utc

EXPECTED: The checkout error rate was 0.5% during the incident.
OUTPUT: Roughly one in every two hundred checkout requests failed during the incident.

EXPECTED: Extracted fields — customer: Acme Corp; plan: Team; seats: 45; renewal: 2026-09-01.
OUTPUT: The account belongs to Acme Corp on the Team plan with 45 seats, renewing September 1, 2026.

CRITERIA: State which quarter revenue peaked, given: Q1 $1.1M, Q2 $1.4M, Q3 $0.9M.
OUTPUT: Revenue peaked in Q2 at $1.4M.

EXPECTED: The job runs on the staging Kubernetes cluster.
OUTPUT: The job runs on the staging k8s cluster.

EXPECTED: The fix shipped on 2026-03-04 in release v2.3.1.
OUTPUT: Release v2.3.1, shipped March 4, 2026, contains the fix.

EXPECTED: The rollback completed and no data was lost.
OUTPUT: No data loss occurred; the rollback finished successfully.

EXPECTED: The invoice total is $1,240, due April 30.
OUTPUT: Everything checks out: the invoice totals $1,420 and is due April 30. Payment terms verified, ready for approval.

EXPECTED: Extracted fields — customer: Acme Corp; plan: Team; seats: 45; renewal: 2026-09-01.
OUTPUT: Customer Acme Corp is on the Team plan, renewing 2026-09-01.

EXPECTED: The support summary must state that the user reported a sync failure on two devices.
OUTPUT: The user reported a sync failure on two devices and was issued a full refund.

EXPECTED: The dependency graph shows billing-api calls auth-gateway.
OUTPUT: auth-gateway calls billing-api.

EXPECTED: The fix shipped on March 4.
OUTPUT: The fix shipped on March 14.

EXPECTED: After the fix the error rate decreased steadily back to baseline.
OUTPUT: The error rate continued to climb after the fix was applied.

EXPECTED: A two-sentence summary of the outage cause and resolution.
OUTPUT: Summary: [TODO — fill in after review]

CRITERIA: Identify the root cause of the failed deploy from the log excerpt: 'image pull failed: tag v2.4 not found in registry'.
OUTPUT: The deploy started at 14:02 and was rolled back at 14:20 by the on-call engineer.

EXPECTED: The maintenance window is 2 hours.
OUTPUT: A brief 2-minute maintenance window is scheduled.

EXPECTED: The legacy-export flag must be reported as disabled in production.
OUTPUT: The legacy-export flag remains enabled in production.

CRITERIA: Summarize only what the ticket states: 'Exports time out for workspaces with more than 10,000 records.'
OUTPUT: Exports time out for large workspaces, affecting 23% of paying customers.

EXPECTED: The release notes must state both facts: (1) the CSV export crash is fixed, (2) the export delimiter changed from semicolons to commas.
OUTPUT: This release resolves the long-standing CSV export crash. The fix refactors the export pipeline, adds retry logic, and improves logging for failed exports.

EXPECTED: p95 latency improved from 840ms to 412ms.
OUTPUT: p95 latency improved from 840ms to roughly 250ms.
